text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-Haha, hahaha, I showed 'em... Yeah, like 
hell that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Nailed my Make Debut! Pretty 
good, huh, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that right, ain't that right? Heheh, 
there wasn't anything to be scared of from 
the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm aiming to be the coolest 
Umamusume there is! Bwahaha!

Even as they gloat, their face is 
twitching. They must have been terribly 
anxious deep down.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the real challenge starts here. 
Hate to break it to ya, but I ain't 
interested in taking it slow and piling up 
achievements bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Big shots have their own way of doing 
things! Trainer, do you know which race 
I'm targeting next?

The next race to target... If we want to 
be ambitious, I'd like to aim for a graded 
race next.

Graded races range from GIII to GI, and 
the competition gets fiercer and fiercer. 
If you're looking for a goal after your 
debut...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, you looking down on me? A 
soft race like that makes me yawn."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not bad. But for me, it's still not quite 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Charging straight into my 
first GⅠ at supersonic speed! Sounds just 
like me, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna blow everyone in the world 
away! Bwa-ha-ha-ha!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"So Trainer, where's the closest GⅠ for 
the Junior Class?"
choice_data_list:
It's either the "Hanshin JF" or the "Asahi 
Hai FS," but...

text_block_list.text:
Two major Junior GⅠ races held in the same 
week. When I told her that 'both are mile 
races with no difference in conditions'—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it really comes down to 
preference. The JF or the FS...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Somehow JF feels cooler! 'J' has a sharp, 
stylish ring to it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, our next target is the Hanshin 
JF! I dunno what JF stands for, but let's 
go with that!

JF stands for "Juvenile Fillies". Let's 
not mention it, though. I have a feeling 
they won't remember it.

And so, although the goal was set to the 
Hanshin JF...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, I heard! Is it true you're entering 
the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Got anything to say to a guy aiming 
for a GⅠ in his very first year?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta have something to say, right? 
Like 'As expected!' or 'That was awesome!' 
Come on, say it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft, humph♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, damn it! You snickered at me! Just 
'cause you can pronounce the race name 
right, don't get cocky, hey!
